desc: Implement the solution using Dynamic Programming with Convex Hull Trick optimization.
Initialize `dp` array (or two rows) where `dp[i]` stores the min cost to partition prefix `i` into `m` subarrays.
Inside, maintain a deque of lines (slopes = `S_cost[j]`, intercepts = `dp[j]`) for the CHT.
Add the line corresponding to `j = i-1` from the previous `m-1` iteration into the hull.
Query the hull for the optimal `j` using $K = S_{nums}[i] + m \cdot k$.
Return the minimum value in the final `dp` row (over all possible $m$).
Verify the logic with Example 1 manually or mentally.
